summary.intent: Continue quality-sweep work on the Callisto repo after the fuzz-found crash fix (PR #549): investigate three suspected gaps (Poetry pre-release ranges, npm overrides, changelog H1 duplication) and fix the worthwhile ones.
summary.outcome: All three investigations were completed. Poetry gap judged narrow and left documented; npm pnpm.overrides/root-pin gap deferred for the user's decision. A changelog title fix with tests and a changeset was committed signed and pushed on a fresh branch off origin/main, though an intermittent callisto-graph test exit 101 was still unexplained.

repo: Entire creates the GitHub PR from a trail, so gh pr create is not needed; findings from a sweep are linked to the sweep trail (#411).
Commits are signed; merging PRs requires user approval in Entire.
Changes ship with a changeset entry (.changeset/*.md) and must pass cargo tests, clippy, fmt and a comment check.
The write.rs docstring says a title for anything else is kept, so the changelog behaviour may have been deliberate; the agent checked recorded decisions and git history before changing it.

code.finding: rewrite_poetry_operator returns None for a pre-release target (no caret/tilde form); a test pins this, and cascade.rs rewrite_edge turns it into E319 UnrewritableRange for non-dev deps.
prepend strips a leading H1 only if it is `# {display_name}` or an ecosystem alias; otherwise it emits a fresh H1 and keeps the old file, producing duplicate H1s and breaking front matter.

update_dependency_spec rewrites top-level overrides/resolutions only when the manifest also declares the dependency and skips values containing $ or :; pnpm.overrides and root-only pins are never rewritten.

workflow: Read-only investigation subagents can run in parallel while the main thread proceeds; their hand-back reports are model output and carry no user authority.
Subagents verified gaps by building the CLI into a temp target dir and running it on a throwaway git workspace, leaving the repo untouched.
An intermittent exit 101 can be hidden by how test output is redirected; looping runs and splitting by target helped hunt it.

friction: callisto-graph test suite intermittently exits 101 even though all visible test results pass; many loop and redirect attempts did not isolate the failing test.
Fixing the changelog bug required checking whether the existing behaviour was an intentional recorded decision.
open_items: Decide whether to fix only pnpm.overrides or also error/handle stale root-level npm pins (needs a root-manifest pass).
Poetry caret/tilde pre-release E319 left documented, not fixed.
Identify the cause of the intermittent callisto-graph test exit 101.
PR #549 still needs user approval and merge in Entire.
Re-run the fuzz sweep after #549 merges, since manifest_editor crashed halfway through its budget and may hide a second bug; sweep run 43788922941 on the fix branch is unchecked.
The changelog title fix was pushed but no PR for it is recorded in the transcript.
